change: Made the ordinary-threshold alternative explicit: deletion is a data-adaptive penalty bounded by 21.6 at frozen settings. Fixed-threshold ablation does not show superiority over a separately tuned moving sum. Treat plateau/burst-duration boundaries as the clearest mechanistic result; dev mean-loss gain over initial is nearly zero.

quality_diagnosis.importance: Suppressing nuisance alarms without missing weak sustained shifts is a concrete sequential decision problem. This study quantifies a duration/sensitivity tradeoff rather than establishing a broad methodological advance.
quality_diagnosis.nearest_neighbor_gap: Mechanism distinctions documented for primary robust segmentation, nuisance GLR, and windowed CUSUM; exhaustive originality remains unestablished.
quality_diagnosis.fairness_gap: Baseline 16 configurations versus initial 12 and refined-stage 12; equal task budgets do not guarantee equally optimized families. Matched deletion-off scan was not retuned.
quality_diagnosis.decisive_evidence: Common unseen evaluation already assigned to coordinator; to identify structured deletion advantage specifically, separately tune the moving-sum comparator on fresh development data before another frozen test.
quality_diagnosis.independent_review: This is the executing agent self-check, not external or independent review.

analytical_boundary.alarm_implications: R>10 implies E>10; E>31.6 implies R>10, with identical window and coverage.
analytical_boundary.scope: Random synthetic evidence arrays check algebra/implementation; no validation scoring or holdout access.
